definitions.explanation: Used mostly in negative sentences to mean 'nothing in particular' or 'not especially.' Occasionally appears in questions asking if there is anything noteworthy.

examples.japanese: とりたてて⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
とりたてて⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とりたてて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have any hobbies worth mentioning in particular.

examples.japanese: とりたてて⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、なんとなく⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: It's not that there's any particular reason, but somehow it bothers me.

notes:
Almost always used with a negative predicate. The literal origin is from ⟦{取|と}り{立|た}てる→取り立てる：20289_toritateru⟧ (to single out, to highlight), so とりたてて means 'singling out' — in negative form, 'nothing to single out' or 'nothing noteworthy.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とりたてて⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no particular problem
- とりたてて⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: nothing unusual in particular
- とりたてて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: nothing worth mentioning
- とりたてて⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no distinguishing features

USAGE:
Very rarely used in affirmative sentences. When used in questions, it asks 'is there anything noteworthy?' — e.g., とりたてて⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧: especially; particularly — more common and versatile, used in both positive and negative sentences
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: not particularly — similar negative-polarity usage, but more casual and sometimes dismissive
- ⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧: exceptionally — literary, used for something standing out positively
